eval-bot: nightly-eval alert: anchor-summary F1 dropped 18% on legalkb prompt set after last deploy. examples attached.

eval-bot: top failing sample (generated):
```
User: summarize ticket #3421 about contract dates
Model: The contract was signed on March 12, 2022 and expires on Jan 1, 2024. The client requested expedited review on 2021-11-05.
```

eval-bot: ground truth mentions no dates, only 'Q4 timeline' and 'approval pending' — looks fabricated.

raj: yikes. which build/quant config?

marta: this was from onboarding-int8 sweep (config: int8+fast-kernel, kernel=nvfuser-aot, detokenizer=legacy). baseline fp16 on same nightly was fine.

sasha: can reproduce locally on NGC image with the int8 artifact. running `python eval.py --seed 42 --suite legalkb --model candidate:int8` produces same sample.

leo: ran a quick compare, it's not just dates — the summary invents a quoted sentence too. looks like the model hallucinates full facts rather than paraphrasing.

marta: hypothesis: quantized attention + kernel choice is causing KV aliasing on long contexts, leading to spurious insertions. also detokenizer change might amplify token merges into dates.

raj: can you paste the exact reproduce command? I'll run a bisect across kernels and detokenizer flags.

sasha: repro command: ```bash
CONDA_ENV=venv-ngc 
python eval.py --model candidate:int8 --kernel nvfuser-aot --detok legacy --prompt-file prompts/legalkb_q4.txt --out tmp.json
jq .tmp[0].generation tmp.json
```

marta: assign: raj -> kernel bisect, sasha -> detok toggle and decode inspect, leo -> run fp16 vs int8 generation diff stats (entity overlap, date tokens). I'll add an eval check for unexpected numeric tokens.

dev-bot: CI job queued: onboard-int8-bisect-1964032100 (https://ci.internal/jobs/77321) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj: starting kernel bisect now. preliminary note: with `nvfuser-opt` the failures drop ~60% in quick pass.

leo: initial diffs: entity-count mismatch correlates with hallucination rate. int8/legacy detok produces more numeric tokens like years.

marta: good. let's hold the int8 rollout for this model. rollback to fp16 baseline for next hosted job and freeze candidate until we verify kernel+detok combos.

sasha: adding quick sanity check to nightly eval: flag samples where model emits >3 new DATE tokens that are not in source. PR incoming.

raj: will follow up with a short run matrix: kernels [nvfuser-aot, nvfuser-opt, triton], detok [legacy, unicode], quant config variants. posting results here in ~45m. :mag:
